log: W13: the arrow key changes the width and the values follow

log: W11: while Check again / Download again waits (claim), no queued download starts; after it, it does
js: (() => { const jobs = state.dl.jobs, act = state.dl.active, orig = window.dlRun; let ran = 0; window.dlRun = () => { ran++; }; try { state.dl.active = null; state.dl.jobs = [{ id: 'tt-test/fake.gguf', status: 'queued' }]; state.dl.claim = { id: 'other' }; dlNext(); const during = ran; state.dl.claim = null; dlNext(); const after = ran; const ok = during === 0 && after === 1; return (ok ? 'OK' : 'FAIL') + ' W11 claim | started while claimed: ' + during + ', after: ' + after; } finally { window.dlRun = orig; state.dl.jobs = jobs; state.dl.active = act; state.dl.claim = null; } })()

log: W11: a file that another tab holds (lock taken) is left waiting with a note, not downloaded twice
js: (async () => { if (!navigator.locks) return 'FAIL W11 lock | no navigator.locks'; const jobs = state.dl.jobs, origNow = window.dlRunNow; let now = 0; window.dlRunNow = async () => { now++; }; const job = { id: 'tt-test/locked.gguf', status: 'queued', note: '' }; let release; const held = new Promise((r) => { release = r; }); const taken = new Promise((ok) => navigator.locks.request('tt-dl:' + job.id, () => { ok(); return held; })); await taken; try { state.dl.jobs = [job]; state.dl.active = null; await dlRun(job); const ok = now === 0 && job.status === 'paused' && /Another TensorTailor tab/.test(job.note) && state.dl.active === null; return (ok ? 'OK' : 'FAIL') + ' W11 lock | runNow calls: ' + now + ', status: ' + job.status + ' | ' + job.note; } finally { release(); window.dlRunNow = origNow; state.dl.jobs = jobs; state.dl.active = null; } })()

log: W8: inLms with its memo gives the same answer for every row as a fresh search; time of a full pass
js: (async () => { const fake = [{ id: 'tt-test/qwen3-8b', publisher: '', path: 'x/Qwen3-8B-Q4_K_M.gguf', type: 'llm' }]; const had = state.lms.models; if (!had.length) state.lms.models = fake; try { const fresh = (m) => state.lms.models.find((y) => lmsLinkOk(y) && state.lmsLinks[y.id] === m.id) || state.lms.models.find((y) => !lmsLinkOk(y) && lmsPairOk(y, m)) || null; let t0 = performance.now(); const want = state.results.map((r) => fresh(r.m)); const tFresh = performance.now() - t0; lmsMemoClear(); t0 = performance.now(); const got1 = state.results.map((r) => inLms(r.m)); const tFirst = performance.now() - t0; t0 = performance.now(); const got2 = state.results.map((r) => inLms(r.m)); const tAgain = performance.now() - t0; let diff = 0; for (let i = 0; i < want.length; i++) if (want[i] !== got1[i] || want[i] !== got2[i]) diff++; const hits = want.filter(Boolean).length; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10)); const cleared = lmsMemo === null; const ok = diff === 0 && tAgain < tFresh && cleared; return (ok ? 'OK' : 'FAIL') + ' W8 | rows ' + want.length + ', in LM Studio ' + hits + ', different ' + diff + ' | fresh ' + tFresh.toFixed(0) + ' ms, memo first ' + tFirst.toFixed(0) + ' ms, again ' + tAgain.toFixed(1) + ' ms | memo cleared after the task: ' + cleared; } finally { state.lms.models = had; lmsMemoClear(); } })()
